Shimura: Option 1: Natural Element (Wind Release) + Kuchiyose (Baku). Option 2: Natural Element (Fuuton) + Tensai (Genius); only Fuuinjutsu and Fuuton can be chosen as versatile powers; Hibon Ninpou cannot be selected. Under option 2 Kuchiyose Baku may be purchased as a common power. Both options can use Shimura Juinjutsu.
Uchiha: Izanagi and Izanami are NPC-only limited aptitudes; the supplement does not reprint the base Sharingan powers.
Uzumaki: Option 2 restricted abilities listed in the supplement: Kagura Shingan, Regeneration, Stamina Regeneration, Kongou Fuusa. The translated page calls the newly described aptitude Regeneration of Vigor; the others refer to earlier rules and are not fabricated here.
Hoshigakure: Restricted abilities: Expanded Chakra (from Basic Book Uzumaki); Kujaku Myoho: Healing; Saimin; Sacrifice. Restricted power: Kujaku Myoho. Unique effect: Flight level 4 with evolution at Flight level 7. Restricted technique: Gen’ei.
